behavior: A fixed Node program runs in the required namespace sandbox before npm, without loading repository code. Required namespace and resource-limit setup and a passing command result must be confirmed.
The preflight and npm share one preparation deadline. Each process must independently confirm its sandbox boundary.

Tracked source/workspace bytes are checked after preflight and installation. Failed preflight, uncertain installation setup, unsuccessful offline npm, and tracked-file changes retain the preparation hold.

Diagnostics distinguish failure before npm from failure of the later sandbox launch and failure of npm within a confirmed sandbox. Existing offline, lifecycle-script-disabled preparation remains in place.
